# Data card: REES46 multi-category store (full data)

*Generated by `scripts/08_model_cards.py` on 16 November 2026. Do not edit by hand.*

## Source
- Public event log of a large multi-category online shop, published by the REES46 marketing platform (Kaggle: *eCommerce behavior data from multi category store*). See the dataset page for its terms of use.
- One row per event: `event_time` (UTC), `event_type` (view, cart, remove_from_cart, purchase), `product_id`, `category_id`, `category_code`, `brand`, `price`, `user_id`, `user_session`.
- Files used: 2019-Oct.parquet, 2019-Nov.parquet, 2019-Dec.parquet, 2020-Jan.parquet, 2020-Feb.parquet, 2020-Mar.parquet, 2020-Apr.parquet.

## Size after cleaning
- 40,111,556 events, 8,871,684 visits, 527,121 visits with a purchase (5.94%).
- Raw input: 411,709,736 events, 89,693,595 visits.

Per month:

| Month | Events | Visits | Visits that buy |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2019-10 | 4,171,557 | 916,327 | 6.72% |
| 2019-11 | 6,465,283 | 1,349,546 | 5.30% |
| 2019-12 | 6,604,569 | 1,538,207 | 5.94% |
| 2020-01 | 5,417,912 | 1,352,255 | 4.80% |
| 2020-02 | 5,379,290 | 1,310,770 | 5.69% |
| 2020-03 | 5,567,115 | 1,253,758 | 6.78% |
| 2020-04 | 6,505,830 | 1,151,222 | 6.79% |

## Cleaning (rows removed, in order)

| Step | Rows removed |
|---|---|
| unparseable event time | 0 |
| null session | 226 |
| session sampling | 370,524,468 |
| unknown event type | 0 |
| non positive or null price | 70,943 |
| duplicate rows | 135,438 |
| over long sessions | 867,105 |

- Session sampling keeps a random 10% of whole visits by hashing the session id (deterministic, seed = first project seed); counts are the sample's, rates represent the shop.
- Prices ≤ 0.0 removed; visits longer than 24 h treated as logging artefacts.

## Category harmonisation
- On 1 December 2019 the log switches to a new category tree whose labels do not describe the products (for example iPhones under `construction.tools.light`).
- Each product is mapped back to its own Oct/Nov 2019 label, or through its new category id to the Oct/Nov label most of that id's products had (≥ 60 % agreement, ≥ 3 products). `src/data/categories.py`.
- 185,958 of 319,295 products have a category after mapping; the rest never had one and stay `unknown`.

## Task construction
- Each visit is cut after its first K events; visits that buy within those K events are dropped so the answer is never in the input. Target: does the visit end in a purchase.

| K | Usable visits | Buy later |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 2,920,763 | 10.5% |
| 5 | 1,895,715 | 9.6% |
| 10 | 838,235 | 8.7% |

- Split by visit start time (70 / 15 / 15 %), with visits that straddle a boundary removed.

## Known issues
- Many products have no category or brand (`unknown`).
- `remove_from_cart` never occurs in this shop's log, so the related feature is always 0.
- Holiday season (Nov–Dec) and early 2020 behave differently; models are tested on later weeks only.

## Personal data
- `user_id` and `user_session` are pseudonymous identifiers; no names, contacts or demographics exist in the data. Neither identifier is used as a model input.
